entries.title: Update now works on a Mac that joined by pasting its link
entries.body: When another Mac joined by pasting its link, Update in Settings → Devices said it updated, but the Mac came back on its old version and the warning said it had not started again. Now that Mac keeps a copy of this computer's version in its work folder at its first Update and starts again on it. The Mac's own installed app is left as it is.
entries.noPicture: Settings → Devices and its lines look the same; the Mac now comes back on the new version instead of the old one.
